appearances.snippet: But look at this email that Jeffrey Epstein authored to Woody (Woody Allen). It says the 23andMe kits arrived and will be delivered to Woody (Woody Allen) and Soon-Yi to their home today.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Reporting based on DOJ-released Epstein records reproduces a September 2016 message saying 23andMe kits had arrived and would be delivered to Woody Allen and Soon-Yi at their home. The existence and wording of the email are supported; no inference about why the kits were ordered is verified.
